high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from en.m.wikipedia.org, specifically the section titled "Electoral success and NAC chairmanship (2004–2014)." The page discusses the electoral success of Sonia Gandhi as the National Advisory Council (NAC) Chair during her tenure from 2004 to 2014. There is a photograph of two individuals shaking hands. On the left is George W. Bush, the 43rd President of the United States, dressed in a dark suit with a red tie. He is seated on a yellow chair.
